subject: Velocity upgrade plan — hosted commit onramp & rate corridor
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@velociti.io>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal options — capacity window question

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the renewal summary you sent last week. We're tracking toward the renewal but traffic forecasts for Q2/Q3 look higher than expected — we'd like to accelerate the committed monthly throughput and reserve a small burst pocket while keeping a controlled rate corridor.

Key asks:
- Increase hosted API monthly commit from our current band to the next tier (estimate ~1.8x).
- Add a burst pool for seasonal campaigns (500k tokens/month) with predictable soft-throttle behavior.
- Want proration guidance if we accelerate mid-term and how billing will show up on the April invoice.

Can we lock a short call to land the numbers? Procurement might join if we get a proration estimate.

Best,
Elena
Elena Park
Head of Platform
Velociti
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@velociti.io>
Cc: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal options — capacity window question
Attachments: Velociti_MAAP_Uplift_Proposal_v2.pdf (application/pdf), SOW-velociti-draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the heads-up on forecast. I've attached a short proposal and a draft SOW that model the uplift you described. High level: 

- Monthly commit: propose moving Velociti from Tier B to Tier C (1.75x baseline tokens/mo).
- Burst pocket: 500k tokens/month soft-pocket with an agreed soft-throttle (starts at 85% utilization) and a fallback to the next compatible model variant when sustained over 48 hrs.
- Proration: if we activate the uplift mid-billing-cycle we'll prorate the delta for the remainder of the cycle and invoice on the next cycle; I included a sample invoice snippet in the proposal.

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick 30-min call to confirm final commit number and burst sizing (I can do 2pm PT Tue).
2) You review the attached SOW and flag any procurement redlines — Kimberly is on copy to help with contract language and billing cadence.
3) If agreed, we'll send a DocuSign envelope and note the effective date for proration.

Looping Jordan for implementation/ops concerns and Kimberly for contracting.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal options — capacity window question

Karthik — quick ops note before the call: if we set the soft-throttle at 85% for a 500k burst pocket we need to confirm expected p50/p95 latencies for their traffic profile. Velociti's campaign spikes are short (minutes to an hour) but can be sharp.

Questions for Elena (if you can surface ahead of the call):
- Typical peak QPS during campaign spikes?
- Percentage of requests that hit long context lengths (>1024 tokens)?

If spikes are very bursty we should recommend a slightly higher soft-throttle point (90%) and a brief autoscale headroom policy so we avoid the model fallback for very short bursts.

I'll prepare an ops note for the meeting with latency tradeoffs and recommended guardrails.

-Jordan
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal options — capacity window question

Thanks — I reviewed the SOW and added a clause around proration and the billing effective date (see attached draft). Two contract points to note:
1) We proposed a 30-day notice for any tier-down after renewal (protects both parties).
2) For the burst pocket, I added language that overage beyond the soft-pocket will be billed at the agreed overage rate and that sustained overages >48 hrs trigger an ops review, not an immediate fallback.

Jordan — I'll leave the operational thresholds to your note but we should lock the soft-throttle threshold in the SOW to minimize ambiguity.

-Kim
Senior Contracts Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Park <elena@velociti.io>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@velociti.io>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal options — capacity window question

Thanks — the proposal looks good. A few clarifications before the call:
- Peak QPS during a campaign typically hits 1200 QPS for short windows (5–20 minutes).
- ~12% of calls exceed 1024 tokens during batch inference.
- Procurement wants an estimate line on the April invoice showing the prorated uplift delta so they can commit internally.

We can take the 2pm PT Tue call if that's still good for you — procurement will join and Kim, it would help to have a sample invoice table.

Elena
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@velociti.io>
Cc: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal options — capacity window question

Great — thanks for the details, Elena. Confirming the plan and next steps from our side: 

1) We will move Velociti to Tier C (1.75x) effective 2027-03-15 for billing/proration purposes; the April invoice will include a prorated delta line (sample in SOW).
2) Burst pocket: 500k tokens/month with a soft-throttle at 90% and overage billed at the agreed rate; sustained overages >48 hrs will trigger an ops review and pre-agreed fallback (model variant swap) only if the customer requests immediate mitigation.
3) Jordan will prepare the ops latency note and recommended autoscale headroom for the onramp.
4) Kimberly will send a final SOW + DocuSign envelope after the call — expected signature window by end of week.

DocuSign (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/velociti/MAAP-Uplift-2027
Slack/Call: I've scheduled a 30-min call for Tue 2027-03-16 14:00 PT (calendar invite sent).

If that all looks good I will get the DocuSign out immediately after the call and confirm the effective date for proration.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Velociti the runway they need for Q2.

—Karthik
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
